integrity: Exact determinant lemma and two exhaustive forest cases prove finite identities; binomial concentration proves the critical limit; finite checker corroborates but does not certify infinite limits. Raw counts independently give the different uniform-forest threshold of order sqrt(q).
scientific_limitations: Only unweighted K_{2,q} graphical zonotopes in their standard root-vector Euclidean normalization; does not infer a universal threshold for other graph families. The all-zonotope wedge-sum theorem is pre-existing and credited. Bibliographic equivalence under alternate terminology cannot be excluded.
title: A two-thirds intrinsic-rank crossover for complete-bipartite graphical zonotopes
